reviews.text: Excellent pet sitter!!  I have used 4Paw Sitting a few times now and have been so pleased.  She is wonderful with my cats and takes such great care of them.  Extremely reliable and goes above and beyond!  I highly recommend!!! 😻😻

Bridget has been an absolutely fabulous sitter for our three rescue kitties and our fish, and has become our reliable go-to when it comes to making sure our pets are well cared for when we are away. We often end up contacting her last minute and she is usually able to accommodate, but the rare times she hasn’t been available, she has gone above and beyond to help us find another sitter who could help us last minute. Bridget is an excellent communicator and reliably sends us daily photos and updates which show our typically skittish kitties relaxed and happy receiving head scratches and attention. We’re so happy to have found her! ❤️
4Paw Sitting is excellent. She does a great job caring for our cat and home while we are away. I highly recommend Bridget.
